module purpose: neorv32_neoled stores a control word written over the bus (enable, frame size mode, strobe command, time-base select, interrupt condition, bit period and high times), queues written data entries tagged with mode and strobe in the data_buffer sub-unit, serializes each entry onto neoled_o as pulse-width-coded bits or as a strobe low period, returns the control word and status on bus reads, raises irq_o from the buffer status, and exports the enable on clkgen_en_o.

use-case flows.value: control settings (enable, frame size mode, strobe command, time-base select, interrupt condition, bit period, 0-bit and 1-bit high times) taken from bus write data when addr(2) = '0', and the enable exported on clkgen_en_o
an entry (strobe & mode & write data) accepted into the TX buffer when stb, rw and addr(2) = '1' hold
entry fetch: buffer read request in state "100", entry loaded into the shift register, frame size and data-vs-strobe command decoded, transition when the buffer reports an entry
bit serialization: time-base tick selection, shift, bit count, per-bit high-time selection, neoled_o high then low after the high time, next bit after the bit period
strobe: neoled_o held low while the strobe counter advances once per bit period until it is all ones
interrupt request from the enable, the interrupt condition setting and the buffer status
status bits on a read: buffer status and transmitter busy
stored control settings and the buffer size returned on a read
control settings, bus response, irq_o, serial engine registers and neoled_o cleared while rstn_i is '0'
disable: buffer held in clear and the engine forced to the others arm (neoled_o low, low state bits "00") while ctrl.enable is '0'
